run_policy: One dedicated hosted push, attempt 1 only. Retain every observation and failure. A new attempt cannot replace this evidence.
candidate: Exact workflow GITHUB_SHA, clean tracked checkout, no untracked files outside .artifacts; source, evaluator, workflow and protocol bytes frozen before tests or timing.

environment.python: 3.12 x64; exact patch and image recorded
environment.text_backend: python for both arms; unchanged native text code is outside these measurements

prospective_contracts: Exact ordered result and float equality with the baseline before and after every measured call.
Untimed cursor audit forbids fetchall, bounds fetchmany to 4096 vectors, and verifies explicit cursor closure.
Exact model identity, fingerprint and consumed artifact bytes; candidate reads and hashes exactly half the baseline artifact bytes.
Separate latency and allocation trials; latency contains no tracemalloc, equality checks, result hashing or event writes.
semantic.allocation_metric: tracemalloc-tracked peak allocations (including NumPy registered buffers); not total RSS or untracked SQLite/native allocations
semantic.limits: Deterministic vectors and mocked tokenizer/ONNX runtime; no actual inference, semantic quality, or end-to-end recall measurement. Result metadata still grows with matched pages.

prospective_contracts: Exact payload and emitted JSON order for every configuration and timed call, using exact historical method AST on the same frozen archive.
Untimed SQL and content materialization audit, bounded to returned previews; no writes or leaked transaction.
All nine configurations, all four alternating AB/BA rounds and all twenty calls per arm retained.
directory.limits: Warm chapter-directory component only; fixture generation, tracing, hashing and equality checks excluded from timing.

interpretation.timing: Keep every raw wall and process CPU observation, including regressions; paired summaries are descriptive, not a universal or end-to-end speed guarantee.
interpretation.cpu: Process CPU is secondary diagnostic evidence and never replaces wall latency.
interpretation.failures: Semantic and directory steps execute independently after their own successful preflight. Any failed component fails the job; incomplete or mismatching output is preserved and never relabeled successful.
interpretation.prior_runs: Earlier development reports and historical formal experiments remain separate, byte-for-byte unchanged.

preservation.layout: Evidence-only parentless Git tree; raw reports, append-only event ledgers, logs, partial failures, dependency install report, frozen sources and evaluator bytes inventoried by SHA-256.
preservation.publication: Create only; no force pushes, deletion or overwrite. A differing existing ref is an error. Additional immutable upload-artifact copy includes preservation diagnostics.
preservation.audit: Standard-library audit checks identities, full balanced observations, exact equality, bounded fetch, and exact half artifact I/O without executing either benchmark.
